topic.angle: Why a false rumour can sink a bank

body.question: A rumour says a bank is about to fail. It is false, and many customers know it. Can a run on the bank still start?
options: No, people who know it is false stay put
Only if the bank really is short of money
Yes, if they suspect others will believe it
body.reveal: Yes. Even depositors who know the story is false have a reason to withdraw if they suspect others will believe it. Banks keep only a small proportion of their assets as cash, so more withdrawals raise the chance of default, which triggers still more. Deposit insurance, like the US FDIC's, is one protection.

probes.question: A bank run can become a self-____ prophecy: more withdrawals raise the chance of default, triggering further withdrawals.
True or false: FDIC deposit insurance covers up to $250,000 per depositor, per insured bank, for each account ownership category.
